title: Taskbar flash / Dock bounce for a background account's message is a pending bool served only at render
trigger: Main window minimized or hidden to the tray; a message arrives for a non-screen account (notify_from_all on). deliver_background sets BackgroundAccounts::attention; only flush_background_accounts (called from a window render) takes it and calls window.request_attention(). The on-screen account's path (notifications/deliver.rs:66-72) instead calls main.update(..request_attention) at once.
effect: No flash or bounce while the window is not drawing; it fires, if at all, only when the window is shown again, when it no longer helps.
fix: Request attention through the main window handle in deliver_background, as the on-screen path does; then the bool is not needed.

title: Restarts entry outlives its account when the account is removed or switched to
trigger: Background account fails to start (Down::Failed, Restarts::failed recorded), then the user removes it (remove_account_in -> stop_background_account) or switches to it (take_background_live). Neither calls restarts.forget; only the 'gone' partition in ensure_background_accounts (a client still in the list) and Ready do. add_account recycles the lowest free id.
effect: A later account under the same key, or the same account after a later failure, starts its restart delay from the old failure count (up to 5 min) instead of 5 s.
fix: Forget the key in stop_background_account and take_background_live, or hold the failure count in the Down::Failed stage.

title: EditStage::Loading has no exit on a failed load: no Retry
trigger: Open Edit Bot; the two loads fail (edit.load_failed()). fill_bot_edit returns early and the stage stays Loading, Save stays disabled.
effect: The box says it could not load the bot and offers only Close; the user must close and reopen to retry.
fix: Add EditStage::LoadFailed with a Retry that calls begin_bot_edit again and holds the new request pair.

title: AudioEngine::fault and ::path sit beside Playback/Sound::Failed and are kept in step by hand
trigger: start() fails: Sound::Failed(None), path Some and Fault::Seen; fail_build sets Sound::Failed and Fault::Unseen/Seen; stop() clears path and fault; a failed resume sets Fault only. No test asserts the three agree.
effect: None today (documented as a log independent of the stage).
fix: Move the error and the retry path into Sound::Failed { track, error, path } so a failed sound carries its reason.

title: SoundMarks keeps call_id: Option, cue and muted as three fields reset together at one site
trigger: sync_call_sounds rebuilds the struct when call.id changes; the summary arm reads call_id and cue separately.
fix: An enum Marks { None, Call { id, cue, muted } } so a cue cannot exist without its call.
